subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can ask and answer: Does … on …?
I can use the days of the week in a game.
I can write sentences with always, often and never.

tf.s: We ask: Does Faisal play tennis on Mondays?
tf.why: Yes! After Does, we say play.

tf.s: We ask: Does Faisal plays tennis on Mondays?
tf.why: After Does, we say play, not plays.

tf.s: A short answer can be: No, he doesn't.
tf.why: Great! No, he doesn't. is correct.

tf.s: A short answer can be: No, he don't.
Days of the week start with a capital letter.
tf.why: Right! Monday, Friday … start with capitals.

tf.s: This sentence is correct: Faisal often read books on friday.
tf.why: We write: Faisal often reads books on Friday.

tf.s: There are six days in the letter snake.
tf.why: Yes! Six days are in the snake and one is missing.

tf.s: Wednesday is the missing day in the snake.
tf.why: Wednesday is in the snake. Tuesday is missing.

tf.s: In the game, a good question can remove many people.
tf.why: Yes! Then you find the person faster.

tf.s: 'Faisal never plays basketball on Mondays' means he plays every Monday.
tf.why: Never means he doesn't play on Mondays.

boxes.q: Which day is missing in the letter snake?
Complete: Does Samira ___ basketball on Tuesdays?
Answer for a girl: Does she read books? (yes)
boxes.why: For a girl: Yes, she does.

boxes.q: Complete: Faisal never ___ basketball on Mondays.
How many days are in a week?
boxes.why: There are seven days in a week.
Days start with a capital letter.

boxes.q: Which word means 'not at any time'?
boxes.why: Never means not at any time.

boxes.q: Complete: ___ Hazim play basketball on Fridays?
boxes.why: With he, we start the question with Does.

boxes.q: In the guessing game, a good pair finds the person with …
boxes.why: Good questions help you find the person fast.

boxes.q: Answer: Does Faisal play tennis on Mondays? (no)
boxes.why: Faisal is a boy: No, he doesn't.

mcq.q: Which is a question for the guessing game?
o: Does Areej ride a bike on Fridays?
Areej rides a bike on Fridays.
mcq.why: Game questions start with Does … on …?

mcq.q: How do we start the word Saturday?
mcq.why: Days start with a capital letter.

mcq.q: Which word goes with he or she?
mcq.why: With he or she, we add -s: plays.
Monday, Friday and Sunday are all days.

mcq.q: Correct this sentence: Faisal often read books on friday.
o: Faisal often reads books on Friday.
Faisal often read books on Friday.
Faisal often reads books on friday.
Faisal often reading books on Friday.
mcq.why: We need reads and a capital F for Friday.

mcq.q: Your secret person is Hazim. He plays basketball on Sundays. Your partner asks: Does Hazim play basketball on Sundays?
mcq.why: Hazim plays on Sundays, so: Yes, he does.

mcq.q: Follow the line: Faisal – always – tennis – Wednesdays. Which sentence is right?
o: Faisal always plays tennis on Wednesdays.
Faisal always play tennis on Wednesdays.
Faisal always plays tennis on wednesdays.
Faisal plays always tennis on Wednesdays.
mcq.why: We need plays, the right word order and a capital W.

mcq.q: Which question is better in the guessing game?
mcq.why: A question that removes many people helps you find the person faster.

mcq.q: Why can it help to colour each day in the snake a different colour?
o: You can see where each day starts and ends
mcq.why: Colours help you see each day clearly.

mcq.q: Faisal never plays basketball on Mondays. Which is true?
o: He doesn't play basketball on Mondays.
He often plays basketball on Mondays.
He always plays basketball on Mondays.
mcq.why: Never means he doesn't do it.
